title: José López Portillo y Rojas to General Bernardo Reyes, 1909 (CEHM DLI.39.7680.2 and sibling records): a proposed numerical substitution key by Alberto Garvía García, partial and not yet verified

documents.shelfmark: Centro de Estudios de Historia de México (CEHM), Archivo del General Bernardo Reyes, DLI.39.7680.2 (record 118144)
documents.route: José López Portillo y Rojas -> General Bernardo Reyes

plaintext.source: Two 1909 telegrams of the same correspondence carry a plaintext beside the cipher (DLI.39.7677.1 and DLI.39.7696.1); the letter itself has none known.

transcription.source: contributor's research transcriptions (gist and Zenodo report); original CEHM images not reproduced and not seen by the project
transcription.notes: 77 cipher groups numbered by position in the contributor's file; not checked against the images.

system.summary: A numerical substitution (code numbers to letters) proposed by the contributor: 28 independently supported number-to-letter values and one provisional value (60 = Y). Not examined by the project.

prior_solution.where: Two sibling telegrams of 15 and 23 July 1909 carry a contemporary plaintext (CEHM 118140, 118185), used by the contributor as controls. No prior reading of the letter found; issue #245, 4-6 Nov 2026.

conditions.human_role: Alberto Garvía García reported the key and the evidence (issue #245, pull request #308). The project has not seen the CEHM images and has verified none of the values.

solution.what: The contributor aligned eight control sequences from two sibling telegrams of 15 and 23 July 1909 with their plaintexts: seven retained controls give 28 distinct number-to-letter values; an eighth, watermark-affected sequence (AYA) adds 60 = Y, provisional.
Project review of the count in issue #245: the strict count is 28; the images were not reachable from the project's environment, so nothing was compared with them.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Contributor's claim: ciphertext-only inference, then supported by the plaintexts of sibling telegrams. Not verified by the project.

credits.note: proposed key (28 supported values, 60 = Y provisional) and evidence packet, issue #245 and pull request #308; Zenodo report doi 10.5281/zenodo.23934776

gaps.item: the CEHM images and the transcriptions have not been seen or checked by the project
gaps.detail: cehm.org.mx is not reachable from the project's environment

outcome.notes: Recorded as a contributed, unverified partial key. No reading is claimed here.
